title: Transition Global Gathering 2027
description: The international gathering of the Transition movement, marking 20 years of Transition, at Salema Eco Camp in the Vicentina Coast Natural Park (Vila do Bispo, Algarve, Portugal), a venue running a regenerative tourism project. Three days of festival (June 4-6) for people from across the movement and aligned organizations, then two optional days of Deep Dives for training and learning (June 7-8); hub members are also invited to strategy meetings beforehand. Camping, glamping, and other accommodation on site, with an accommodation discount for participants. Registration and a dedicated website open in November 2026.
